1. Adjust Screen Brightness: One of the easiest methods to improve the battery life of your smartphone is to adjust the screen brightness level. Reducing the brightness of your device can help save power.

2. Turn Off Automatic Updates: Automatic updates can drain your battery. Therefore, it is recommended to disable automatic updates or schedule them to take place during off-peak hours.

3. Use Dark Mode: Dark mode uses less power than the regular screen mode, especially on OLED displays.

4. Turn Off Location Services: Turning off location services on apps that don't require them can also save a significant amount of battery life.

5. Limit Push Notifications: Receiving notifications requires regular phone activity, which eventually reduces battery life. Hence limit push notifications to essential ones only.

6. Uninstall Resource-Intensive Apps: Certain games and apps use a lot of resources and can put a strain on your phone's battery life. Removing them will significantly help save battery life.

7. Disable Bluetooth, Wi-Fi and GPS: Devices like Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, and GPS also consume significant battery life. It is recommended to disable them when not in use.

8. Use Battery-Saving Mode: Most smartphones come with battery-saving modes that help save power by reducing background processes, vibrations and notifications.

9. Turn Off Haptic Feedback: Haptic feedback consumes a significant amount of battery life. Disabling this feature can add more life to your phone battery.

10. Use Battery Saver Apps: There are some apps available on both Android and iOS that manage battery life by inducing battery-saving settings.

Vegan Chickpea Curry

Ingredients:

1 can of chickpeas, drained and rinsed

1 small onion, chopped

2 cloves garlic, minced

1 tablespoon olive oil

1 tablespoon curry powder

1/2 teaspoon cumin

1/2 teaspoon coriander

1/2 teaspoon turmeric

1/2 teaspoon paprika

1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper

1 can of diced tomatoes

1 cup vegetable broth

1 cup chopped spinach

Salt and pepper to taste

Directions:

4. Add the chickpeas, diced tomatoes, and vegetable broth. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 10-15 minutes.

1/4 cup maple syrup

1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Pinch of salt
